description: This file defines a class SentTableConfigResolver that configures and manages the display and actions for a notification requests table in the Thingsboard UI, including fetching data, handling user actions, and rendering status and error indicators.

classes.name: SentTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides configuration for the notification sent requests table, including data fetching, user actions, and UI rendering logic.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for notification requests.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up action descriptors for table cells, such as 'notify again'.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create or resend a notification request, optionally updating the data after closure.

methods.name: onRequestAction
methods.description: Handles user actions like adding or resending notification requests.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the status of a notification request with appropriate styling.

methods.name: requestStats
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying error count and stats for a notification request.

methods.name: requestStatusStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for status text based on request status.

methods.name: openStatsErrorDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog to display errors related to notification requests.
